Message:
As we gazed on at the
brilliantly burning estate,
Moineau told me
the truth about everything.

And about those who likely
requested my assassination.

“Though, that is only a hunch,”
Moineau added.
But, I was sure she was right.

“More importantly,
are you quite certain
you’re alright with this?
If you stay with me...
you might get...”

“I do not feel pain,
so it is no matter,” she says...
My word, don’t say such things,
even as a joke...

I held the silver coin
up to the sky.
The full moon
reflected on its surface
made it look just like
a star shining in the night.

“Let us go, Moineau.
Getaways are best made
under the cloak of nightfall.”

To that, she said,
“If we move in haste,
we will only get separated.”
Hehe...

Even if we do,
you’ll simply come
and find me again,
won’t you, Moineau?”

Two lone stars
bearing the same scar
drift through the night.

Even when the light of dawn
masks their glow,
as long as they remain together,
then surely...
